policy.text: First word_limit words of the held-out split; split by words before BPE
policy.targets: Both models score words 2..word_limit; the complete first word is context only
policy.denominator: word_limit, including the initial context word, as in the assignment example
policy.tiny_context: Up to 128 previous true tokens; each target scored once
policy.probabilities: Original model probabilities; no temperature or top-p filtering
policy.bigram_unknowns: Unknown words are mapped to the existing pt01 <UNK> token
